newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mondale says US a bit worried about Japan economy.
newsitem.headline: Mondale says US a bit worried about Japan economy.

text.p: U.S. ambassador to Japan Walter Mondale said on Wednesday the United States was "a little worried" about the state of the Japanese economy because stimulative financial measures were coming an end.

Mondale told a news conference that U.S. Treasury officials and their Japanese Finance Ministry counterparts were talking "almost daily" about how to keep the sluggish Japanese economic recovery going.
"We are a little worried about the Japanese economy," Mondale said.
He said U.S. officials, in their contacts with Japan, were urging Tokyo to pay close attention to policies that are needed to keep the economy moving.
Mondale declined to make any comment about the dollar's recent surge against the yen.
